title: Kam Air to Start Daily Flights Between Kabul and Islamabad
excerpt: Afghanistan's Kam Air is increasing its flight frequency between Kabul and Islamabad to daily services starting November 1.
body_html:
Afghanistan’s Kam Air is set to increase its flight frequency between Kabul and Islamabad, transitioning to daily services starting from November 1.

This operational update will provide passengers with more frequent travel options between the two cities.
